<thought>We need to create an ML‑ready tabular dataset from the consolidated nitride polymorphs JSON using advanced feature engineering, a 20 % test split, and normalization. The tool will also generate a metadata JSON file (by default named ml_dataset_metadata.json) inside the specified output directory. After running the tool we will return the path to that metadata file.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_14/nitride_polymorphs/consolidated_nitride_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
